t: Essentials 6-gang, surge-protected extension lead for straightforward multi-socket power distribution with 2-metre cable length and power indicator. Rated at 13A and 3000W capacity, this unswitched strip accommodates 6 x standard UK plugs for powering tools, appliances and equipment. Shuttered sockets enhance safety by preventing foreign object insertion, whilst the replaceable fuse protects against electrical faults. Wall-mounting holes enable permanent fixing to benches or walls for tidy cable management in workshops and garages. IP20 rated for indoor use with 230V operation.
b: Wall-Mounting Holes Enable Permanent Workshop Installation
Replaceable Fuse Provides Basic Electrical Fault Protection
